fields.name: ecosystem
fields.meaning: The runtime the package belongs to: node for TypeScript and JavaScript.

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The package's own name, as a specifier writes it: graphql, @scope/pkg, node:fs.

fields.name: place
fields.meaning: The line and column the import opens at, which tells a repeated edge from another.

fields.name: specifier
fields.meaning: The specifier as the importing file writes it.

fields.name: form
fields.meaning: How the file names the module: static, type, dynamic, require or re-export.

fields.name: names
fields.meaning: The names the import takes, as the module exports them; absent when it takes none.

fields.name: type_only
fields.meaning: Whether every binding the import takes is a type.
